# Jev as a pre-filter in front of the LLM (generated by prefilter.py)

Jev first on every neighborhood; the LLM sees only neighborhoods at or above the threshold; the rest are closed as ordinary with no LLM call. A threshold of 0 is the LLM on all 60 (the baseline). Thresholds chosen on main against Sonnet v3 and applied unchanged to heldout_a, where only Sonnet v2 exists. 'Ring units closed unseen' = planted rings the LLM never saw. Note that on the verdict numbers a pre-filter and the gate are the same arithmetic (a closed neighborhood and a dropped ring call both end as 'ordinary, nothing flagged'); what the pre-filter adds is the LLM calls, cost and time saved.

## set 2, facts-only state, p(ring): main, Sonnet v3

LLM on all 60: $0.8953 and 422.5 s of model time in total; Jev adds $0.0050 and 7.0 s for 60 calls (serial; 4 s at 8 workers).

| Jev threshold | neighborhoods sent to the LLM of 60 | rings found of 20 | false rings of 40 | ring units closed unseen | LLM cost saved | LLM time saved |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.0 | 60 | 13 | 5 | 0 | $-0.005 (-0.6%) | -7.0 s (-1.7%) |
| 0.3 | 25 | 10 | 3 | 7 | $0.4812 (53.7%) | 227.0 s (53.7%) |
| 0.5 | 21 | 10 | 2 | 8 | $0.5505 (61.5%) | 259.2 s (61.3%) |
| 0.7 | 12 | 9 | 0 | 10 | $0.6921 (77.3%) | 326.3 s (77.2%) |
| 0.9 | 9 | 7 | 0 | 12 | $0.7473 (83.5%) | 351.7 s (83.2%) |
